classification_contract.distinct_binding_boundary: Structural binding difference only; not statistical independence or semantic orthogonality.
classification_contract.identity_rule: Same repository-relative implementation module and normalized effective hook AST digest, plus identical canonical static binding payload.
classification_contract.source_digest_boundary: Normalized effective adapter hook AST; it is structural identity, not a claim of semantic equivalence or identical historical behavior.
classification_contract.unresolved_policy: Fail open; dynamic or ambiguous bindings are never guessed.
